description: Black and white portrait of O’Keeffe and Juan Hamilton touching his circular sculpture in his studio. O’Keeffe stands in profile, hair pulled back and arm stretched out with her hand on the sculpture. She wears a black suit and white shirt with her Calder pin at her neckline. Hamilton, wearing a shirt and jacket, stands next to her looking down with his fingertips on his sculpture.
title: O'Keeffe and Juan Hamilton, Barranca, New Mexico
